kind: Static original Director score audit; no runtime execution or original-file modification

originalSources.rule: exitFrame goes to the current frame
Every display member is copied with ink36 and base registration minus member registration
Layers BG/Body/Eyes/Mouth occupy channels120/121/122/123; assignments change members without overriding score ink
CPshowFace positions channels120..124 using shared registration anchor; no ink override

result.rule: Use BackgroundTransparent exact white key throughout active animation layers; all pixels of background color are transparent, irrespective of connectivity. Cleared score records on later frames are inactive and do not establish another compositing profile.
